description: Say what a thing is before you build or check a 3D model of it: its family, the parts a model needs (and which move, about which axis, with the pivot where), a typical size range with its source and a confidence class, variants, Godot conventions (+Y up, front faces +Z), what to anticipate and the usual mistakes. Works from a name in English or Dutch (plurals, typos, compounds like 'vrachtauto') or a description ('something with wheels and an engine'). A word that means two things is reported as ambiguous; something unknown gets the nearest family, marked generic. Use it for the full facts about a thing, and its archetype name for godot_model_lint; for one short page that also names the ready-made kind and the spec format, use godot_model_brief instead. Read-only.

text.description: what you want to make or check, e.g. 'a tractor', 'helikopter', 'wind turbine'

name: godot_model_identify
title: What is this thing?
